drafted_from: workflow:keep-each-told-change-in-the-history's own file (tools/workflows/recipes/keep-each-told-change-in-the-history.json) and its run in the change-chain proof: a made-up booking service told booking 101 added, changed and cancelled, and each became one statement of a history on PGlite.
start_here: Say to your AI: "Keep every change my sources tell in my history." The AI switches on this workflow's wake (chosen--a-change-a-source-told) with your own input {history: {credential_name: <your history's vault name>}}, and workflow:route-each-row-change's wake a-row-changed; then each change a source's waiter row gives kinds to is kept once in your history.
no_lists_because: It writes one row of the person's own history (the statements table of the history-and-identity mechanism), in the person's own database, with one statement; it keeps no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Have the history in your own database (statements, mentions and their rule rows) and its connection in your vault; switch this wake on with {history: {credential_name: <that vault name>}}.

2. Give your history a meaning or mention rule for each source it keeps (meaning_rules and mention_rules, source = the source's vault name, place = its table or list): a told change is kept only when a rule names its source and place, or names none. Give a service's waiter row shape.kinds rules too when other workflows should be chosen by its kinds, and shape.carry for the values your readers need (a booking's starts_at, email, cancelled_at).
3. Add meaning_rules and mention_rules rows to your history for that source, so a kept change gets its meaning (booked, moved, cancelled) and the addresses it names.
4. Switch on chosen--a-change-a-source-told here and a-row-changed on workflow:route-each-row-change.

worked_examples.title: A booking made is kept once as a booked statement
worked_examples.ask: (the noticer told booking 101 added, kinds ["call-booked"]; the router chose this workflow)
worked_examples.given: A history on PGlite with the meaning rule (place booking, change added) -> booked and the mention rule $.after.email -> email.
worked_examples.hands_back: One tool:run-sql-in-my-database call that inserts statement 1 (source my-booking-service-key, place booking, change added, key 101) and answers {id: 1, meaning: booked}; the same fact told again inserts nothing (ON CONFLICT (source, told) DO NOTHING).
